title: New Boss
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael and the staff welcome Charles as the new VP, with Michael showing enthusiasm and introducing him to the office. The episode features office interactions, a celebration for Michael’s anniversary, and Charles's initial engagement with the staff, including announcing lunch on him and dissolving the Party Planning Committee. Tensions and uncertainties about Charles's role and the management structure are present, but the episode primarily focuses on introductions and office dynamics.
